ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the output stage is composed of the upper transistor VT1 and the lower transistor VT2, and the power supply is the vertically symmetric +VCC and -VCC; the output node is located between VT1 and VT2, and is connected to the load RL on the right, the lower end of the load is connected to the reference ground, and the output voltage uo is marked across RL. Reasoning: When the upper transistor VT1 is made to conduct as much as possible, the positive peak value of the output is limited by the saturation voltage drop, with the maximum approximately +VCC - |UCES| = 12 - 2 = +10 V. When the lower transistor VT2 is made to conduct as much as possible, the maximum negative peak value of the output is approximately -VCC + |UCES| = -12 + 2 = -10 V. Therefore the maximum peak-to-peak value is 10 - (-10) = 20 V.

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure: the load is referenced to ground and the output node is driven alternately by upper transistor VT1 toward +VCC and lower transistor VT2 toward -VCC. Use the given VCC = 12 V and |UCES| = 2 V. The largest positive output is 12 - 2 = +10 V, and the largest negative output is -12 + 2 = -10 V. Therefore the maximum peak-to-peak output voltage is (+10) - (-10) = 20 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中输出级由上管 VT1 和下管 VT2 组成，电源为上下对称的 +VCC 与 -VCC；输出节点位于 VT1、VT2 之间，并连接到右侧负载 RL，负载下端接参考地，输出电压 uo 标在 RL 两端。推理：当上管 VT1 尽可能导通时，输出正峰值受饱和压降限制，最大约为 +VCC - |UCES| = 12 - 2 = +10 V。当下管 VT2 尽可能导通时，输出负峰值最大约为 -VCC + |UCES| = -12 + 2 = -10 V。因此最大峰峰值为 10 - (-10) = 20 V。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct rail-headroom route: it treats the figure as a dual-supply complementary output stage and finds the two limiting output-node voltages directly, without using the load current.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the diagram that VT1 and VT2 form a push-pull/emitter-output power stage between the +VCC and -VCC rails, with the output node tied to their common emitter/output connection and RL connected from this output node to ground; uo is measured from output to ground.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the numerical givens VCC = 12 V, identical VT1/VT2, |UCES| = 2 V, and the requested quantity being maximum peak-to-peak output voltage.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For a complementary class-B/AB emitter follower with symmetric supplies, the output can approach each supply rail only to within the conducting transistor's saturation voltage. Thus the positive limit is +VCC - UCES and the negative limit is -VCC + |UCES|; peak-to-peak swing is their difference.

method.method_draft: After identifying the circuit paths in the image, compute the maximum positive load current: Ipk+ = (VCC - |UCES|)/RL = (12 - 2)/8 A. The positive output peak is Ipk+ RL = 10 V. By symmetry and identical VT1/VT2 parameters, the negative half-cycle gives the same magnitude, -10 V. The full peak-to-peak voltage is 2 × 10 V = 20 V.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: At maximum undistorted swing, the active output transistor just reaches saturation, so the voltage available across RL on either half-cycle is the supply magnitude minus the transistor saturation drop. With identical upper and lower transistors and symmetric ±VCC rails, the positive and negative peak magnitudes are equal.
